videos.title: Die young as late as possible | Dr Douglas Hilbert | TEDxCambridge University
videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description: Dr. Douglas Hilbert argues that living longer only matters if we can stay healthy, active and fulfilled. Drawing from his experience as a doctor and his own struggles, he highlights three principles: make time for your health, recognize how relationships shape your habits, and advocate for yourself.
